data.message: I’m heading to security for my last cameras task.

I found Bob’s body in cafeteria and reported immediately.

My route this round was oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> navigation -> security -> weapons -> cafeteria. I saw Diana in upper_engine around ticks 4-5, and I saw Bob pass from upper_engine to lower_engine around tick 4. Later Bob went lower_engine -> storage around tick 9, and I saw him in storage around tick 13. He left storage toward medbay around tick 14, then Diana entered storage from lower_engine around tick 15.

Most importantly, I saw Bob alive in weapons at ticks 24 and 25. After that I went to cafeteria and found him dead there. I don’t know who killed him, but the kill had to be after I saw him alive in weapons.

I was nowhere near cafeteria at the end. My route was medbay -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> back through lower_engine/upper_engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security.

I didn’t see Bob at all this round. I saw Diana in lower_engine around tick 13, then in storage ticks 16-17. I also saw Diana leave storage toward navigation at tick 18. I saw Frank moving around lower_engine/storage area around tick 21. Then I saw Alice enter medbay from electrical at tick 25, so Alice was pretty far from cafeteria/weapons at the time Eve says Bob was alive.

Based on Eve saying Bob was alive in weapons at 24-25, I think the kill is very late. Diana and Frank are the only ones I have near the storage/navigation side earlier, but I can’t place either at cafeteria. Alice seems less likely from my view because she was in medbay at tick 25. I’d like to hear Diana and Frank’s routes especially.

My route was lower_engine -> upper_engine -> oxygen -> back through upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> navigation -> security -> electrical.

I saw Bob early in upper_engine at ticks 3-4, and Eve was also there around ticks 4-5. After that I didn’t see Bob again at all. I entered storage later; I saw Eve in storage around tick 15, then Charlie in storage ticks 16-18 after he entered from lower_engine. I left storage toward navigation after that and continued to security/electrical.

So if Eve’s info is right that Bob was alive in weapons at ticks 24-25, then the kill was definitely late and my storage timing around 15-18 shouldn’t be the kill window. I never went to cafeteria or weapons at the end.

Charlie saying Alice was in medbay at tick 25 makes Alice sound less likely. I really want to hear Frank’s route, because he’s the one not accounted for late, and also Eve was the last known person near Bob/body location since she says she saw him alive in weapons then found him in cafeteria. Not accusing hard yet, but for me the important people to explain are Frank and Eve.

My route was security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> lower_engine.

I saw Alice in security early, ticks 2-4, after she entered security from weapons at tick 1. I did not see Bob at all this round, and I didn’t see Eve or Diana either. The only later person I saw was Charlie at tick 21 entering lower_engine from storage, which matches him saying he saw me around lower_engine/storage.

I passed through weapons/cafeteria earlier, but not at the end when Eve says Bob was alive in weapons at ticks 24-25. If that timing is accurate, then this was a very late kill near weapons/cafeteria. Charlie placing Alice in medbay at tick 25 makes Alice less likely. Diana’s storage/nav/security/electrical route seems backed up by Charlie too.

From what we have, Eve is the one with the closest timing to Bob being alive and then dead, since she says she saw him alive in weapons and then found him in cafeteria right after. I’m not saying it’s definitely Eve, because she did report, but that’s the biggest point of suspicion to me unless Alice has info that changes it.

I can confirm parts of what people said. I started weapons into security and was with Frank in security early, ticks 2-4-ish. He definitely didn’t kill early there.

After that I was mostly bouncing electrical/medbay doing tasks — Charlie is right that he saw me come into medbay from electrical around tick 25, so I was not on the weapons/cafeteria side when Eve says Bob was alive in weapons at 24-25.

I didn’t see Diana late, and I didn’t see Bob until the report happened, so I can’t add much on the actual kill moment. From the timing, this has to be super late. That makes me look less at Diana/Charlie based on their routes, and more at the people closer to weapons/cafeteria timing-wise.

I’m not hard accusing Eve just because she reported, but Eve’s story has her seeing Bob alive in weapons and then immediately finding him dead in cafeteria. That’s very tight. Frank also passed weapons/caf earlier but says not late, so I’m between Eve and Frank right now, leaning Eve if we’re voting on closest timing.

I want to push back a bit on everyone tunneling me just because I reported. I gave the exact timing because it’s important: Bob was alive with me in weapons at ticks 24-25, then I went into cafeteria and found the body. I reported immediately.

If I were the duck, calling such a tight self-report with my own timing would be a really bad story to volunteer. The kill is late, yes, but that doesn’t automatically mean reporter.

Alice seems pretty cleared by Charlie seeing her in medbay at tick 25. Diana’s route is partly backed by Charlie too, and I only saw her earlier in storage. I’m more worried about the people who were near security/weapons/cafeteria or unaccounted for late. Frank says he was lower_engine at the end, but the last hard confirm on him is around tick 21 near lower_engine/storage. Charlie also ended security, which is closer to weapons than medbay/electrical, though his story has more corroboration.

For me, I don’t think Alice. Diana is less likely. I’m between Frank and maybe Charlie, leaning Frank because his late location has the least confirmation after tick 21.

I’ll restate my key info now that I’ve heard everyone: I was medbay → upper_engine → lower_engine → storage → back through lower_engine/upper_engine → medbay → electrical → security. I never saw Bob this round.

My strongest clears are Alice and probably Diana. I saw Alice enter medbay from electrical at tick 25, which makes it really hard for her to be killing Bob in weapons/cafeteria right then. Diana I saw lower_engine/storage around ticks 13, 16, 17, then leaving storage toward navigation at 18, so she fits the earlier part and doesn’t seem like the late kill.

Frank I only saw around lower_engine/storage at tick 21, and after that his end position is basically self-reported. Eve is also in the tightest timing: Bob alive in weapons at 24-25, then dead in cafeteria, and she reports. I agree reporting doesn’t automatically mean guilty, but that is still the closest confirmed timing to the body.

So for me it’s really between Eve and Frank. I’m not voting Alice, and I’m not very interested in Diana. I’m leaning Frank slightly because Eve at least reported and gave the tight timing, but I’m not fully confident.

I’ll add my side again and then where I’m landing.

I never saw Bob after upper_engine ticks 3-4. I saw Eve there too at 4-5, then later I saw Eve in storage around tick 15. Charlie entered storage from lower_engine at tick 16 and I saw him there through 18, then I left toward navigation/security/electrical. I never went weapons or cafeteria late.

Given Eve saw Bob alive in weapons at 24-25, my earlier storage timing doesn’t fit the kill window. Alice being in medbay at 25 from Charlie’s info also makes her pretty unlikely. I feel okay about not voting Alice, and I’m not really suspicious of Charlie’s earlier route because I personally saw part of it.

The issue is the late window. To me it’s still between Eve and Frank, with maybe a small possibility on Charlie if he was late security, but less so. Frank’s last hard placement is tick 21 around lower_engine/storage, then everything after is self-reported. Eve has the tightest timing with Bob alive and then dead, but she did report and gave that information openly.

I’m leaning Frank slightly over Eve right now because Eve reporting could be genuine, and Frank’s late end location has the least confirmation. But I’m not 100% — if people think the self-report timing is too tight, I understand Eve votes too.

I need to defend this because I think people are weighting “unconfirmed after 21” more than actual opportunity.

My last hard placement is Charlie seeing me in lower_engine at tick 21. Bob is alive in weapons at 24-25 by Eve’s own report. That means the kill is after that, in cafeteria, right next to where Eve says she was. I was not seen in weapons/cafeteria late, and I did not see Bob at all.

Eve reporting doesn’t clear her. A self-report with tight timing can absolutely happen if the killer knows they’re the last one with the body and wants to control the story first. Her version is basically: “I was with Bob alive in weapons, then immediately found him dead in cafeteria.” That is the closest possible opportunity we have.

I’ll also say Charlie ending security is physically closer to weapons than my lower_engine placement, but I’m less on Charlie because multiple people have pieces of his route. Alice sounds clear from medbay at 25, Diana sounds earlier and corroborated.

So I’m not voting Alice or Diana. If the choice is me or Eve, I’m voting Eve. The actual kill window points way more to the person with Bob at 24-25 than to me being somewhere else at 21.

I’m still not voting Charlie/Diana based on how much of their routes got cross-confirmed, and Charlie seeing me medbay at 25 is exactly why I don’t think this can be on me.

For the actual choice, I get Frank’s point that Eve had the tightest timing, but the problem is Frank’s late position is basically unconfirmed after Charlie saw him around lower_engine/storage. Eve at least reported immediately and gave the timing that makes her look bad, which feels a little less like a duck play to me.

So I’m landing Frank over Eve here. Not 100%, but if we’re voting between those two, Frank has the weaker late alibi.
